title: betterbackups
description: a little mod to view your backups in minecraft
body:
# BetterBackups  

Never lose your worlds again.  

**BetterBackups** adds a simple and user-friendly backup manager directly into Minecraft. Browse, manage, and organize your world backups without leaving the game.  

## Features  

✅ In-game backup browser  
✅ Displays all backups from the Minecraft `backups` folder  
✅ Shows the size of every backup  
✅ Displays the total size of the backup folder  
✅ Open the backup folder with a single click  
✅ Clean and lightweight interface  
✅ Fully integrated into Minecraft's GUI  

## Why BetterBackups?  

Managing backups through your file explorer can be inconvenient, especially when you have dozens of backup files. BetterBackups provides a dedicated screen where you can quickly view and organize your backups directly from inside Minecraft.  

Whether you're a casual player or a modpack creator, BetterBackups helps you keep track of your saved worlds and storage usage.  

## Current Functionality  

* View all available backups  
* Display backup file sizes  
* Display total backup folder size  
* Open the backup folder from within the game  

## Planned Features  

* Restore backups directly in-game  
* Delete backups from the backup screen  
* Search and sort backups  
* Backup creation with one click  
* Additional information such as creation date and world name  

## Compatibility  

* Client-side mod  
* Works with existing Minecraft backups  
* No server installation required  

## Feedback & Suggestions  

Found a bug or have an idea for a new feature? Feel free to leave feedback and help improve BetterBackups.  

---  

**Keep your worlds safe. Manage your backups with ease.** 📦💾
